sample.method: first 50000 rows returned by each public resource; descriptive sample, not a population estimate

case_evidence: DAPRE publishes base form 899999083 in both transactional datasets.
IEMP publishes attached check digit 8300157281; base-only filtering returns zero.
Fondo Financiero Distrital de Salud publishes attached check digit 8002469532.
Valle publishes 890399029, 8903990291 and 8903990295 for related units.
The DAPRE directory itself publishes 899999083, 8999990839 and 8999990830 under different registered names; suffix stripping alone is not identity authority.

strengths: Stable against spelling and punctuation changes.
Can retrieve all verified source names for a strict one-to-one identity.
risks: Base, attached check digit and punctuated forms differ by source and buyer.
A common NIT can denote multiple physical units and accidentally create a buyer group.
Blind suffix stripping can collapse unrelated or invalid publications.
Global population coverage was not proven; the full aggregate timed out and only a 50000-row descriptive sample was frozen.

strengths: Preserves the exact physical buyer boundary represented by each verified binding.
Supports one or several names without aggregating every unit under a NIT.
risks: Bindings can drift and require dated evidence and re-audit.
Exact punctuation and accents are source data.

A_aliases_db_fields.reason: It remixes alias ownership, canonical display and source projection in the same record family.

B_untyped_sidecar_json.reason: Separation is correct, but an untyped sidecar cannot enforce 1..N, dataset names, unique keys or provenance.

C_typed_source_registry.reason: A small typed registry can load a dedicated JSON sidecar while keeping resolver and gazetteer contracts backward compatible.

D_dynamic_nit_derivation.reason: It imports network availability, format normalization and buyer-group decisions into every query. Keep it as audit/reconciliation evidence.

recommended_model.persistence: dedicated JSON sidecar loaded and validated by a typed module

recommended_model.projection_semantics: An existing binding emits exact equality predicates joined by OR. No binding returns None and preserves the current canonical-name path. No fuzzy matching is sent to Socrata.
recommended_model.authority: The registry is projection authority only. It cannot add aliases, change canonical display, merge identities or create buyer groups.

implementation_v1_scope: Typed source-name registry with schema validation and a dedicated sidecar.
DAPRE as the only initial runtime binding.
Dataset-aware exact projection for p6dx-8zbt and jbjy-vk9h.
Backward-compatible fallback to current entidad_resolved behavior for every unbound identity.
Focused tests for identity/display stability, both datasets, zero-row current projection, source-aware counts via fixtures, multi-name OR semantics and fail-closed schema validation.
A separate regression test must expose the current full-phrase QueryRouter gap for 'Presidencia de la República'; discovery does not authorize alias expansion.
